binary.sha256_note: sha256 of the executable file itself

model_route: OpenRouter via `-m openrouter/<model>`; key read from OPENROUTER_API_KEY env
isolation: OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR={HOME} replaces ~/.config/opencode; project-level opencode.json in the probe cwd for MCP. Claude-Code compat + external skills disabled so the user's ~/.claude skill library (which pushed a bare PONG to ~159k input tokens in a smoke test) is not injected.

one_shot.method: spawn argv, 120s hard timeout (SIGTERM then SIGKILL on the process group); true iff the process exits by itself and stdout+stderr (with every echo of the prompt text removed) contains PONG

file_edits.method: after the run, read <cwd>/PROBE.txt from the fresh temp dir; true iff it exists and equals "probe-ok" (one trailing newline tolerated)

tool_use.method: true iff stdout+stderr (prompt echoes removed) contains TOOL-OK-4471 (as specified). Caveat: the token is in the prompt, so a model that merely repeats it would pass; corroborated with (a) tool-call event lines matched by tool_call_regex and (b) the file_edits result, which is on-disk proof of tool execution
